# Introduction

This document includes supplementary data and computational details related to the paper "Krill oil supplementation with and without resistance training lowers the burden of the metabolic syndrome but does not affect glucose tolerance in sedentary adults: a randomized controlled trial". 


## Project organisation

This notebook is built from source code available at the github repository [trainome/alpha-omega-trial](https://github.com/trainome/alpha-omega-trial/) **[TODO: confirm repository URL; the local git origin is github.com/dhammarstrom/alpha-omega-trial]**. The data used in analyses is organized as an R data package available in a separate repository [trainome/AOData](https://github.com/trainome/AOData/).    

Files used to build this supplementary document, the figures and the methods and results section of the paper are listed in @tbl-project-files. Stan models are stored in `models/`; when model code is executed locally, compiled model executables are also stored here. Model fits are stored in `fits/paper1/` but are not pushed to GitHub due to their large size. Model fits are recreated by running the model scripts in `models-scripts/`.

| File | Content |
|:----------------|:----------------------------|
| **Book chapters** | |
| `_quarto.yml` | Book configuration: chapters, authors, execution and output settings. |
| `index.qmd` | Introduction, project organisation and computational environment. |
| `01-data.qmd` | Analytic approach and description of the data set and participants (figures 1 and 2). |
| `02-fa.qmd` | Effects of krill oil supplementation on fatty acid composition (models m2 to m6). |
| `03-metsyn-intro.qmd` | Introduction to the metabolic syndrome analysis, including the drop-out analysis (model m1). |
| `04-metsyn-models.qmd` | Development of the metabolic syndrome models on synthetic data (models s1 to s7). |
| `05-metsyn-postpred.qmd` | Posterior predictive checks, model expansions and model comparison with LOO (models s7 to s18). |
| `06-metsyn-simulations.qmd` | Simulation study comparing the multivariate (s13) and univariate (s18) models. |
| `07-metsyn-inference.qmd` | Inference on the metabolic syndrome criteria, the joint burden score, diagnosis and moderation of treatment effects (models s13, s18 to s22). |
| `08-metsyn-sensitivity.qmd` | Sensitivity of conclusions to the model structure and to the scale of the burden score. |
| `09-ogtt.qmd` | Analysis of the oral glucose-tolerance test (models mo1 to mo4). |
| `10-results.qmd` | Book version of the methods and results sections of the paper. |
| **Paper** | |
| `_methods-results.qmd` | Shared body of the methods and results sections, included by `99-methods-results.qmd` and `10-results.qmd`. |
| `99-methods-results.qmd` | Methods and results section of the paper (rendered to Word). |
| **R scripts** | |
| `R/packages.R` | Loads required packages. |
| `R/data-prep.R` | Prepares data for all analyses, including `data_load_s7s10()` that creates the Stan data for the metabolic syndrome models. |
| `R/helpers.R` | Helper functions for model fitting (`fit_wrap()`, `make_inits()`) and post-processing of model output. |
| `R/fig-opt-fun.R` | Color scale, theme and other settings for data visualisations. |
| `R/sim-fun.R` | Functions for simulating data sets used in model development and simulation studies. |
| `R/negligible.R` | Thresholds for negligible effects (from `01-data.qmd`) and probabilities of benefit, negligible effect and harm from posterior draws. |
| `R/pop-ref.R` | Population reference values for the metabolic syndrome criteria, burden score weights and conversion factors to the population-SD burden score. |
| `R/model-comp.R` | Simulation study comparing models s7 to s10 on data with a shared residual SD across treatment arms (output in `data-sim/`). |
| `R/model-comp2.R` | As `R/model-comp.R` with treatment-specific residual SDs in the simulated data (output in `data-sim2/`). |
| `R/model-comp3.R` | Simulation study comparing s13 and s18 under different levels of missingness and correlation (output in `data-sim3/`). |
| **Figures** | |
| `figures/figure-01.R` | Figure 1, participant flow (CONSORT) diagram. |
| `figures/figure-02.R` | Figure 2, study design and training data. |
| `figures/figure-03.R` | Figures 3 and 4, omega-3 index and fatty acid composition with group contrasts. |
| `figures/figure-05.R` | Figure 5, OGTT, fasting glucose and HOMA2-IR. |
| `figures/figure-06.R` | Figure 6, effects of krill oil supplementation on the metabolic syndrome. |
| `figures/figure-0<n>.RDS` | Saved figure objects, read by `_methods-results.qmd` (figures 3 to 6) and created by the figure scripts. |
| `figures/figure-<n>.pdf`, `figures/figure-<n>.svg` | Figures 1 to 6 for submission, created by the figure scripts. |
| **Stan models** | |
| `models/m1.stan` | Drop-out analysis, log-odds of drop-out per treatment group predicted from baseline characteristics. |
| `models/m2.stan` | Fatty acid composition, complete-case ANCOVA-style model. |
| `models/m3.stan` | Fatty acid composition, all available data with imputation of missing values. |
| `models/m4.stan` | As m3 with treatment-specific residual SD. |
| `models/m5.stan` | As m3 with time-specific residual SD. |
| `models/m6.stan` | As m3 with time- and treatment-specific residual SD. |
| `models/mo1.stan` | OGTT, multilevel spline model at baseline. |
| `models/mo2.stan` | OGTT, multilevel spline model for three time-points. |
| `models/mo3.stan` | As mo2 with imputation of missing values. |
| `models/mo4.stan` | As mo3 with participant-level intercepts per time-point. |
| `models/s1.stan` | Metabolic syndrome criteria, separate models per criterion on complete cases. |
| `models/s2.stan` | Joint multivariate normal model of the criteria. |
| `models/s3.stan` | As s2 with imputation of missing values. |
| `models/s4.stan` | As s3 with sex as a predictor. |
| `models/s5.stan` | As s4 with both follow-up time-points, without correlations between time-points. |
| `models/s6.stan` | As s5 with a single correlation structure across types and time-points. |
| `models/s7.stan` | Univariate normal model with imputation of missing values. |
| `models/s8.stan` | Joint multivariate normal model with correlation across types and time-points. |
| `models/s9.stan` | As s7 with treatment-specific residual SD. |
| `models/s10.stan` | As s8 with treatment-specific residual SD. |
| `models/s11.stan` | As s9 with a Student-t likelihood. |
| `models/s12.stan` | As s10 with a multivariate Student-t likelihood. |
| `models/s13.stan` | As s12 with residual scales per time and type; the model used for inference. |
| `models/s14.stan` | As s10 with a latent-factor correlation structure. |
| `models/s15.stan` | As s12 with a latent-factor correlation structure. |
| `models/s16.stan` | As s14 with residual scales per time and type. |
| `models/s17.stan` | As s15 with residual scales per time and type. |
| `models/s18.stan` | Univariate Student-t counterpart of s13. |
| `models/s19.stan` | As s13 with a treatment × own-baseline interaction. |
| `models/s20.stan` | As s13 with a treatment × baseline metabolic burden interaction. |
| `models/s21.stan` | As s13 with a treatment × baseline relative fat mass interaction. |
| `models/s22.stan` | As s13 with a treatment × baseline omega-3 index interaction. |
| **Model fitting** | |
| `models-scripts/model-<model>.R` | Fits a model to the trial data and saves the fit (and LOO) in `fits/paper1/`, e.g. `model-s13.R`. `-D6` scripts fit s14 to s17 with six latent factors. |
| `models-scripts/refit-all.sh` | Refits all models fitted to the trial data. |
| `models-scripts/refit-s7-s20.sh` | Refits models s7 to s20. |
| `models-scripts/refit-s13-s22.sh` | Refits models s13, s18, s21 and s22. |
| `models-scripts/refit-s14-s17-d6.sh` | Refits models s14 to s17 with six latent factors. |
| `models-scripts/<model>-run.log` | Console output of the latest fit of each model, written by the refit scripts (`-D6` logs for s14 to s17 with six latent factors). |
| `fits/paper1/` | Saved model fits and LOO objects (not on GitHub). |
| **Derived data** | |
| `data-derived/chain-diagnostics-s7-s10.RDS`, `data-derived/chain-diagnostics-s11-s12.RDS` | Chain diagnostics of models s7 to s12 (chapter 5). |
| `data-derived/ch-07-diag-crit-rubin-s13.RDS`, `data-derived/ch-07-diag-crit-rubin-s18.RDS` | Analyses of metabolic syndrome diagnosis in 500 imputed data sets (posterior draws) from s13 and s18, combined with Rubin's rules (chapter 7, figure 6 and paper). |
| `data-derived/ch-07-chain-diagnostics-s19-s22.RDS` | Chain diagnostics of the moderation models (chapter 7). |
| `data-derived/ch-07-moderation-*.RDS` | Summaries of moderation parameters, predictions and burden score moderation (chapter 7). |
| `data-derived/ms-s13-alpha-beta-draws.RDS`, `data-derived/ms-s19-s20-draws.RDS`, `data-derived/ogtt-mo4-pop-draws.RDS` | Cached posterior draws from models s13, s19, s20 and mo4, used in the paper (re-created when older than the fits). |
| `data-sim3/` | Output from the simulation study in `R/model-comp3.R` (chapter 6). |
| **Resources** | |
| `resources/bibliography.bib` | References. |
| `resources/typst-show.typ` | Typst template partial adding authors and affiliations to the PDF. |
| `resources/vancouver.csl` | Vancouver citation style for the book and the Word version of the paper. |
